# Learn to Paint Watercolor

> > A comprehensive watercolor learning platform offering tutorials, courses, and community support led by instructor Matthew White.

Learn to Paint Watercolor provides beginner-friendly instruction through video tutorials, step-by-step guides, and an active artist community. The site features both free resources and paid courses covering fundamental techniques, landscape painting, sky work, and composition principles.

## Key Topics

- Watercolor painting
- Painting techniques
- Color mixing
- Composition
- Wet-into-wet method
- Value studies
- Landscape painting
- Sky techniques
- Focal points
- Light-to-dark technique
- Matthew White
- Watercolor Community
- WCSP system
- Beginner-friendly instruction
- Artist growth mindset

## Core Platform

- [Homepage](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com): Main hub offering watercolor tutorials, courses, and community with Matthew White
- [Course Store](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/store): Course store featuring Watercolor Essentials, Master Skies, and community products
- [Watercolor Community](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/watercolor-community-open): Watercolor Community enrollment featuring WCSP system with video tutorials and painting critiques
- [Watercolor Community Alt](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/resource_redirect/landing_pages/2149418330): Watercolor Community membership with Success Path system and painting critiques

## Tutorials & Techniques

- [Paint the Sunset](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/blog/paint-sunset-in-watercolor-tutorial): Step-by-step watercolor tutorial for painting sunset light with supplies list
- [Paint a Crashing Wave](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/blog/painting-waves): Full-length watercolor tutorial for painting crashing waves with color mixing techniques
- [Watercolor Sky Techniques](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/blog/watercolor-sky-techniques): Four watercolor sky techniques using wet-into-wet and color mixing methods
- [Creating Depth in Watercolor](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/blog/creatingdepth): Three key techniques for creating depth using color temperature and composition
- [How to Paint Landscapes](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/blog/landscape-tips): Watercolor landscape tips using rule of thirds for depth and composition
- [Watercolor Painting Background](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/blog/watercolor-painting-background): Creating complementary backgrounds that support focal points in watercolor paintings

## Tips & Guides

- [Blog](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/blog): Weekly watercolor tips, techniques, and video tutorials from Matthew White
- [Accelerate Watercolor Growth](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/blog/tips-I-wish-I-knew): Foundational watercolor tips covering light-to-dark technique and painting process
- [One Simple Tip](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/blog/one-simple-tip): Watercolor painting tip using value studies and grayscale method for composition
- [10 Quick Watercolor Tips](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/blog/10tips): Quick watercolor tips covering brush technique, paper selection, and color mixing
- [Drawings to Guide Paintings](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/blog/drawing): Drawing tips for watercolor sketches covering composition, perspective, and focal points

## Free Resources & Learning

- [Free Resources](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/freeresources): Free watercolor resources including 5 Essential Steps guide and supplies information
- [5 Step Planning Guide](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/resource_redirect/landing_pages/2150431669): Free 5-step planning guide for composition and watercolor painting fundamentals
- [How to Create When Uninspired](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/blog/how-to-overcome-creative-block): Techniques to overcome creative block and artist motivation with growth mindset

## Studio & Resources

- [Studio Tour](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/blog/studiotour): Studio tour showcasing workspace setup, equipment, and painting supplies recommendations

## Optional

- [Calendar](https://www.learntopaintwatercolor.com/calendar): Calendar product featuring watercolor paintings with eco-friendly specifications
